test-people.sql: CREATE TABLE people (id INT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, dept VARCHAR(20), salary NUMERIC(9,2)); INSERT INTO people VALUES (1,'Ann','IT',3000.00),(2,'Bob','IT',3500.50),(3,'Cleo','HR',2800.00),(4,'Dan','HR',NULL),(5,'Eve','Sales',3100.00);

test-sql-001.title: TEST: IT employees
test-sql-001.instructions: Show the names of all employees in the IT department, sorted alphabetically.
test-sql-001.referenceSolution: SELECT name FROM people WHERE dept = 'IT' ORDER BY name
hints: Filter with WHERE, then sort with ORDER BY.
test-sql-001.explanation: WHERE filters rows; ORDER BY sorts them.

test-sql-002.title: TEST: average salary per department
test-sql-002.instructions: Show each department and its average salary. Departments may appear in any order.
test-sql-002.referenceSolution: SELECT dept, AVG(salary) FROM people GROUP BY dept
